facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports that the Ministry of Revenues and the Ethiopian Customs Commission unveiled eight digital systems on 12 October 2025, including an AI-based Customs Chatbot.
Addis Fortune reports that the Ministry of Revenues and the Ethiopian Customs Commission unveiled an AI-powered Passenger Risk Management System among eight digital systems on 12 October 2025.

ETH.note: Nothing on local government revenue records.
Systems named include e-receipts and e-tax refund, but electronic payment of taxes or fees is not stated.
Online filing or payment of tax returns is not stated; only named systems with no description.
